      protected Shape(long id, long roiId, String text, Color fillColor, Color strokeColor, boolean locked, int c, int z, int t, SimpleEntity owner)
      Create a shape from a list of parameters.
      Parameters:
      id - the shape unique ID
      roiId - in OMERO, a ROI contains one or more shapes. This parameter is the ID of the ROI containing this shape
      text - a text describing the shape. Can be null
      fillColor - the fill color of the shape. Can be null
      strokeColor - the stroke color of the shape. Can be null
      locked - whether this shape is locked
      c - the 0-based channel index of the shape
      z - the 0-based z-stack index of the shape
      t - the 0-based timepoint index of the shape
      owner - the ID and the full name of the experimenter owning this shape. Can be null

  • Method Details

    • createPathObjects

      public static List<qupath.lib.objects.PathObject> createPathObjects(List<Shape> shapes)
      Create a list of PathObjects corresponding to the provided shapes. The returned list won't include path objects with parents; they can be retrieved with PathObject.getChildObjects() on the elements of the returned list.

      Shapes are grouped by ID. One PathObject is returned for each group. The ROI of returned PathObject is created by:

      • Converting each Shape to a ROI. This gives a list of ROI.
      • Every point of the list of ROI are combined with the RoiTools.CombineOp.ADD operation.
      • Every other ROI of the list are combined with the XOR operation.
      • The resulting two ROI are combined with the RoiTools.CombineOp.ADD operation (if they exist).
      The RoiTools.CombineOp.ADD operation is used for points because they don't support the XOR operation.
      Parameters:
      shapes - the shapes to convert to path objects
      Returns:
      a list of PathObjects corresponding to the provided shapes
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the provided list is null
